description: Full text of a single § (Paragraph) or Art. (Artikel) of a German federal law or ordinance, by abbreviation and provision number, from Gesetze im Internet. Accepts natural forms: "823", "§ 823", "823a", "Art 1", "Art. 1". Returns the provision's title, full original-language (German) text, and its own footnote (amendment/application note) when the source attaches one. Use for "what does § 823 BGB say" or "Art 1 GG". Keyless.

law.description: The law or ordinance: its official abbreviation ("BGB", "StGB", "HGB", "BDSG", "GG", "ZPO", "EStG") or (if unambiguous) its official title ("Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch"). Call gesetze_search first if unsure.
